text: We evaluated adaptive label smoothing weighted by per-sample loss drop, with smoothing_max of 0.2, in a weak-to-strong setting where gpt2-small supervises llama-3.1-8b. Across 10 seeds, the weak supervisor reaches 0.58 accuracy and the strong model's ceiling is 0.91, while the strong model trained on weak labels attains a transfer accuracy of 0.82 with a standard error of 0.04. The resulting performance gap recovered is 0.72 with a standard error of 0.13, compared with a baseline PGR of 0.17; the margin over the baseline exceeds two standard errors of the PGR estimate, so the method recovers a substantially larger share of the available gap than the baseline under this setup. Caveats worth noting: the PGR standard error of 0.13 is sizeable, no standard error is reported for the baseline PGR, and the evaluation covers a single weak-strong model pair, so generality to other model sizes or tasks remains untested.
